literal_meaning: চাঁদির জুতো ফেলা বা মারা (silver shoe throwing or hitting)
figurative_meaning_en: To spend money lavishly or generously
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চাঁদির জুতো মেরে সেই দামি গাড়িটা কিনে ফেলল।
ব্যবসায় সফল হতে হলে কখনও কখনও চাঁদির জুতো মারতেই হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He threw money around to buy that expensive car.
To succeed in business, sometimes you have to spend lavishly.
history: This idiom originates from the idea that throwing silver shoes (valuable items) can make any task or work get accomplished easily, symbolizing the power of wealth in resolving issues.
note: The expression highlights the cultural perception in Bengal that money can expedite processes or overcome obstacles.
